item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Federal judge won't make disgraced clerk pay Alex Murdaugh's $600,000 in legal fees for 1st trial
item.description: A federal judge has thrown out a lawsuit by Alex Murdaugh seeking $600,000 in legal fees by the former court clerk whose misconduct led his murder convictions to be overturned on appeal.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Florida AG Uthmeier issues subpoena to investigate Dr. Anthony Fauci
item.description: Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier issued a subpoena as part of an official investigation into former NIAID director Dr. Anthony Fauci.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Senate confirms Dr. Erica Schwartz as new CDC director
item.description: The Senate confirmed Dr. Erica Schwartz as director of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, placing her in charge of a public health agency beleaguered by political meddling and low morale.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] UFC parent company took a $30M hit on White House fight event
item.description: UFC's parent company, TKO Group, lost $30 million from its Freedom 250 event held at the White House in June.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Fuego volcano spews more ash and mud as Guatemala shelters 1,700 who fled nearby villages
item.description: Guatemala raised a red alert after the Fuego volcano erupted, displacing 1,700 people and affecting 29,000 more with ashfall.
